in_sanskrit.name: रुत्वि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has his/her own will and is unconquerable.

in_hindi.name: रुत्वि
in_hindi.long_meaning: स्वतंत्र (Svatantra): Self-ruled or self-willed. अनन्तर्जित (Anantarjit): Unconquerable or invincible.

in_tamil.name: ருத்வி
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஆட்டம் (Aattam): Beloved. அவர்களிடம் ஆக்கியம் (Avarkalitham Aagiyam): Possession of the one who is dear to us.

in_telugu.name: రుట్వి
in_telugu.long_meaning: స్వాతీయమోదేశ (Svaateeyamodhesa): One who is the lord of one's own self. ఆశీశ్వర (Ashishvara): God of all, supreme lord.

in_marathi.name: Rutvi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Joy, Laughter, Creativity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rutvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rutvi means one who brings joy and laughter. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rut' which means joy and 'Vi' which means one who brings. Rutvi is a name that represents creativity and is often associated with the Moon.
